Introduction

8TURN, formerly known as BOM (Boys Of MNH), is an eight-member boy group under MNH Entertainment. They made their official debut on January 30, 2023 with the mini album 8TURNRISE.

The group's name means 'the turn of eight boys with infinite potential' and reflects their ambition to lead a new generation in the Kpop scene, referencing their eight members.

On March 6, 2024, 8TURN made their Japanese debut with the digital single Ru-Pum-Pum (Japanese Ver.). 8TURN also participated in Road to Kingdom: Ace of Ace.
